purpose: Live city parcel qualification with unmodified responses through the repository adapter; IDs and hashes retained, full geometries confined to temporary audit cache except three public samples.

identitySemantics.identityMeaning: Provider row identifier; stable for exact WFS reads but not represented as a legal parcel-number key.
identitySemantics.parcelIdUniqueness: PARCEL_ID is not unique in the inspected layer: one bounded query returned three rows for PARCEL_ID=1076459. OBJECTID is used as the unique source identity.
